title: Son, father 70: 'sounds drunk', words mixed up, doesn't drink

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 742 Lincoln Way. It's my father, he's 70.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He sounds drunk. His words are all mixed up, he's saying things that don't make sense.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, he doesn't drink at all. That's why it's so weird.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is he awake and breathing normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah, he's awake, he's sitting in the living room.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About an hour ago. He called me and he sounded totally normal.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with him.
